title: CSV export is missing my last task
body: I ran `tasklite export > tasks.csv` and the newest task is not in the file. I have 12 tasks and the CSV has 11 rows. Version 2.4.1 on macOS.

comments.body: Same on Linux, 2.4.1. Always the last one.

title: Add --json flag to list
body: Feature request: `tasklite list --json` so I can pipe into jq in my CI scripts. Parsing the [ ] boxes is fragile.

title: Due date 'tomorrow' is wrong in the evening
body: I'm in California (UTC-7). At 6pm I add a task with --due tomorrow and it shows the day after tomorrow. In the morning it's fine.

title: Export takes 40 seconds with 10k tasks
body: I have about 10,000 tasks (imported from another tool). `tasklite export` takes ~40s. Smaller lists are instant.

title: Recurring tasks
body: Would love tasks that repeat — e.g. 'water plants every Monday'. Right now I re-add them by hand every week. Should handle daily/weekly/monthly at least.

title: Typo in help text: 'tasklite lsit'
body: The help says lsit instead of list.

title: Lost all my tasks after laptop crashed
body: My laptop ran out of battery while I was adding a task. After reboot ~/.tasklite.json was empty (0 bytes) and every task was gone. 200+ tasks. Please make saving safer.
